term: bounded joint omission of rigid candidates
definition: UpTo F present w k means that for each n ≤ k and each function selection : Fin n → I, there is an accessible v at which every selected candidate is absent. Duplicate selections are allowed; all subsets of size at most k are thereby represented. The n=0 case requires a successor even if I is empty. In the singleton profile Slot has exactly three constructors a,b,c, the universal frame accesses all three, and singletonExists x v means literal equality x=v. Hence all worlds are inhabited by their matching candidate. These definitions stipulate formal populations and do not defend their metaphysical possibility.
